name: Claude Cowork
best_for: Delegating file and desktop work to Claude
notes: Included in every paid Claude plan: Pro $20 monthly ($17 yearly), Max $100, Ultra $200. Team seats listed $25 monthly / $20 yearly (product page says $20), 2 to 150 seats. Computer use is Pro/Max/Ultra only. Product page says Cowork is becoming just Claude.

name: OpenClaw
free_plan_limits: Whole tool is free; you pay your AI model provider
since_note: First released November 2025 as Clawdbot, later renamed OpenClaw (Wikipedia mirror; Fortune).
best_for: Self-hosters wanting a free personal agent
notes: MIT license; run by the OpenClaw Foundation nonprofit with no paid tier. You still pay for the AI model you plug in. Browser, desktop and scheduling features not stated in what we read.

name: Hermes Agent
free_plan_limits: Free software; model provider and hosted services billed separately
since_note: Nous Research says it released Hermes Agent under MIT in February 2026.
notes: MIT license. Bring your own model key or use Nous Portal. Optional always-on cloud agents have their own pricing, not stated. Browser, desktop and scheduling not stated in what we read.

name: Manus
free_plan_limits: 300 credits a day (1,500 a month cap), 1 task at a time, 2 scheduled automations
usage_note: Pro includes 4,000 credits a month; unused credits expire
notes: Pro $20 a month for 4,000 credits, $40 for 8,000. 17% off yearly. Team from $20 per seat. Help center is the source; a Manus blog mentioned a $200 tier that the help page does not.

name: Claude in Chrome
free_plan_limits: Not on the free Claude plan
since_note: Piloted in 2025 per Anthropic's blog; exact month not checked.
best_for: Letting Claude work inside your own Chrome
notes: Included in Pro ($20 monthly, $17 yearly), Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise. Chrome only; no mobile or other browsers. Enterprise has it off by default. Scheduled shortcuts run from the extension.

name: ChatGPT agent
usage_note: Plus: 40 agent messages a month; Pro 400; Business 40
since_note: Introduced in 2025 per OpenAI's launch post; exact month not checked.
best_for: Web tasks inside a ChatGPT subscription
notes: Message caps come from an OpenAI help article about 6 months old. Pro price is unclear (tiers shown at $100 to $500; older page $200). Business seats $25 monthly / $20 yearly. Runs on OpenAI's virtual computer, not your PC.

name: Genspark
free_plan_limits: Weekly free quota for standard-mode tasks; size not stated
since_note: Company founded 2023; public launch June 2024 per secondary reports.
best_for: One subscription for many AI models and agents
notes: Plus $24.99 monthly or $19.99 yearly; Pro $249.99 monthly or $199.99 yearly (125,000 credits). Browser, desktop and scheduling not confirmed from official pages.

name: Lindy
free_plan_limits: One-time $50 credit that expires after 7 days
usage_note: 5,000 credits a month; top-ups $10 per 1,000; credits do not roll over
best_for: AI assistants for email and sales tasks
notes: Sources disagree: Lindy's billing docs list Pro $99.99 (15,000 credits) and Max $199.99 (35,000). The pricing page snippet says $49.99 for 5,000 credits. Check the live page.

name: Perplexity Comet
free_plan_limits: Browser is free; no Comet Assistant queries without a paid plan
since_note: Free worldwide release on Oct 2, 2025, per Perplexity's changelog; earlier invite phase not checked.
best_for: An AI browser that does web tasks for you
notes: Pro $20 monthly or $200 yearly; Max $200 monthly or $2,000 yearly (highest agent limits, parallel tasks). Comet Plus is $5 on its own and included with Pro and Max.
